Proof in the paper: The calcined La0.9Sr0.1NiO3 sample showed LaNiO3 perovskite as the dominant phase with the main diffraction peaks at 2θ = 23.3, 33, 41.3, 47.4, 58.7, 68.8, 69.8, 78.7°. The calcined La0.9Sr0.1Ni0.5Fe0.5O3 sample showed diffraction peaks only for a pure perovskite phase. The XRD peaks at 2θ = 32.2 and 57.4° can be attributed to LaxSr1–xFeO3.
